Require a printed self-audit inside every finding, and calibrate severity from it. Each finding must state (a) the population/denominator/operating point of BOTH sides of every comparison and confirm they match (fleet-wide vs per-host, per-token vs per-request, per-GPU vs aggregate, mean vs percentile, submitted vs completed, dense vs sparsity, service time vs response time); (b) one benign alternative reading and why it fails; (c) the reviewer's own substitution, re-derived before filing; (d) the specific decision a reader would get wrong. P1 requires a wrong architecture decision; wording, taxonomy, notation, unit, or single-glyph operator errors are P2/P3. Findings whose quoted clause is truncated, or that do not separate 'quoted clause' from 'observed defect', are returned unreviewed. This targets CH6-OVERSUB-PEAK-FLOPS (fleet demand vs one host), CH2-01 (5.6 TB/s aggregate vs 3.35 TB/s per GPU), CH11-§11.6-01 (benign fragmentation reading), and the P1 severity assigned to FIG16-02, FIG-8.3-01, TBL-12.2-02 and CH2-01 (DeepSeek).
